title: Support nested list ticket URLs
description: Extend browser routing, ticket links, and documentation so a task opened from the list resolves at /<project-id>/list/<task-id>.
why: People need stable links that preserve the list as the ticket's navigation context: /<project-id>/list/<task-id>. Direct ticket links should remain supported.

acceptance.text: /<project-id>/list/<task-id> opens the list with that ticket selected
List-origin ticket navigation writes nested list paths while existing direct ticket paths continue to work

todos.text: Add the nested list ticket route to the parser and URL builder
Preserve the list context in ticket links and browser history
Document the route and run full checks

outcome.summary: Added nested list ticket URLs, routed list-origin links through /<project-id>/list/<ticket-id>, preserved list context on browser back, and documented the paths.
outcome.verifiedBy: npm run check passed: 122 tests passed, 1 optional real-model test skipped; includes route parsing, generated UI script parsing, server shell for nested list ticket path, and 404 handling.
